summary: Implemented user authentication UI: AuthContext provider with login/logout/password-reset state management, useAuth hook, login form with phone+password inputs and localStorage token storage, two-step password reset form (request code via SMS then enter code+new password), AuthLayout wrapper that gates the app behind login (with subscribe link bypass), and logout button in bottom nav. App requires login on every open with no automatic session restoration. All styled with existing Tailwind color scheme including loading spinners and inline validation errors.
